CA.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation relation to identified content present.

COD.rationale: Content (red positions) plus an explicit origin/representation entry provide content identification, organization/access metadata and a separable status for the same referent/time.

A.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation or processing condition tied to the same identified content's organization/access is stated.

C.rationale: Multiple literal entries identify represented content (color-labeled position sets) with attribute labels.

D.rationale: Origin/representation metadata is reported separately from the content identity for the same referent, distinguishing content from its status/ provenance.

O.rationale: Entries describe how contents are represented/presented (current vs candidate, origin kinds, grid coordinate orientation).
